file_path.description: The path to the PDF file to analyze.

min_pw.description: Minimum password length to try. Corresponds to --minpw.

max_pw.description: Maximum password length to try. Corresponds to --maxpw.

charset.description: Character set to use for password generation. Corresponds to --charset.

wordlist.description: Path to a wordlist file for dictionary attacks. If empty, wordlist mode is not used. Corresponds to --wordlist.

load_state.description: Path to a saved state file to continue a previous session. Corresponds to --loadstate.

use_owner.description: Enable owner password recovery mode. Corresponds to --owner.

user_password.description: Known user password to speed up breaking the owner password. Corresponds to --password.

permutate.description: Enable password permutation (e.g., switching first character to uppercase). Corresponds to --permutate.

quiet.description: Run quietly, suppressing progress output. Corresponds to --quiet.
